method: tools/derive-water-actors.mjs over a read-only native trace of the recorded winning route

podoboo.note: remake feet y = native y + 24; v0 6.2 is the mean of 5.9-6.5 fitted per jump (apex native y 64-90); relaunch at native y 254

swimCheepGenerator.note: Native BulletBillCheepCheep (object 23) consumes EnemyFrenzyBuffer 23 set by ROM AreaFrenzy commands; EndFrenzy clears it. Lowest free slot below 3, FrenzyEnemyTimer 32, right extent+32 (camera+287). Random byte s >=170 selects SwimCC_IDData[1], inverted outside World 2. Enemy17YPosData plus CheckpointEnemyID adder 8 gives heights; BitMFilter skips used heights and resets at 255. Generated fish use the same native swimming motor as placed fish.
